sources.entry: SlimHUD - Cyanocitta - Replacement for MacOS' volume, brightness and keyboard backlight HUDs.

summary.one_liner: SlimHUD is a macOS app that replaces the system's volume, brightness and keyboard backlight overlays with a slimmer, customizable HUD.
summary.what_it_does: SlimHUD shows its own on-screen indicator when the volume, screen brightness or keyboard backlight changes, replacing the default macOS overlay. Settings are opened by launching the app again while it is already running. Users can toggle a small icon under the bar, enable a shadow effect, and pick among several animation styles. It can also check continuously for changes so the HUD appears when a slider such as the Touch Bar's is used. Each bar and icon can have its own color, the muted volume color can be set, and the bar size and screen edge (left, right, top or bottom) are adjustable. A launch-at-login option is included, and automatic updates use Sparkle.
use_cases: display HUD on Touch Bar Mac
how_to_run: Or download the latest release and move it to /Applications
notable: Replaces the default macOS volume, brightness and keyboard backlight HUDs
Continuous change detection option for Touch Bar sliders
Adjustable HUD size and screen edge placement
caveats: Icon coloring is only available on macOS 10.14 and later
Uninstalling requires disabling launch at login or deleting the app to restore system HUDs
